What You Will Learn

  • Understanding valuesSee light and dark clearly, the heart of realism.
  • Facial features & proportionsPlace eyes, nose and lips with confidence.
  • Mastering the blending stumpSmooth tonal transitions and soft shadows.
  • Capturing realistic texturesHair, skin and fabric that feel alive.
  • Preserving whites & highlightsKeep sparkle and depth in your portraits.

Progress depends on each student’s starting level and practice.

Art Is a Journey. Mine Brought Me Back to My Passion.

I’m Shipra Aggarwal, a charcoal artist and art instructor. My journey began with studying fashion designing. After marriage, life took me in different directions, and years later I returned to art.

Today I create realistic charcoal portraits and teach charcoal art and painting to children and adults.

“Sometimes, the passions we return to become the most meaningful part of our journey.”
